purpose: Client helper for creating authenticated checkout order IDs, placing customer orders, and listing profile order history through same-origin Next proxies backed by SHRESTA-BE.
businessRules: Proceed-to-checkout creates or reuses a backend checkout draft through /api/customer-orders/draft before the customer enters checkout.
The checkout draft response carries orderId, orderNumber, backend cartSignature, totals, item snapshots, and expiresAt for the 15-minute checkout window.
Final order placement must send draftOrderId so SHRESTA-BE can verify the draft is active, unexpired, customer-owned, and cart-signature matched.
Frontend sends product IDs and quantities only; SHRESTA-BE resolves product names, SKU, prices, media, and snapshots before DB insert.
Draft creation and order placement require Idempotency-Key and an HTTP-only customer session cookie handled by same-origin route handlers.
Browser cart must clear only after the backend returns a persisted order response.
Profile order history reads customer-owned order summaries keyed by the authenticated customerId.
